title: SecurePackage
description: Draft-07 JSON Schema specification for UXSP SecurePackage wire payload.

data_type.description: Payload data type (e.g. TEXT, JSON, BINARY, FILE, VIDEO, AUDIO, PHOTO, STREAM).

is_chunked.description: Whether package is split into multiple streaming chunks.

envelope.description: Single sealed envelope payload for non-chunked packages.

chunks.description: List of sealed envelope chunk objects for streaming/chunked packages.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata associated with the package.
